name: digital-human-studio
description: A privacy-first, local-first desktop workbench that turns a screenplay into a multi-shot AI short drama: LLM storyboarding, character assets, budget gates and per-shot video generation.
author: francoeur003

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check desktop.mjs && node --check lib/drama/schema.mjs && node --check lib/drama/store.mjs && node --check lib/drama/llm.mjs && node --check lib/drama/agents.mjs && node --check lib/drama/budget.mjs && node --check lib/drama/pipeline.mjs && node --check lib/drama/comfyui.mjs && node --check lib/drama/routes.mjs && node --check lib/drama/subtitle.mjs && node --check lib/drama/ffmpeg.mjs && node --check lib/drama/audio.mjs && node --check lib/drama/compose.mjs && node --check lib/drama/series.mjs && node --check lib/drama/version.mjs && node --check lib/drama/prompts.mjs && node --check lib/drama/materials.mjs && node --check lib/drama/queue.mjs && node --check lib/drama/export.mjs && node --check lib/drama/suggestions.mjs && node --check public/drama.js && node --check lib/seedance.mjs && node --check tests/fixtures/fake-seedance-runner.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run smoke
scripts.build:mac: electron-packager . 'Digital Human Studio' --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=studio.zaorenju.desktop --app-category-type=public.app-category.video --app-version=0.4.3 --icon=assets/icon.icns --ignore='^/(release|docs/screenshots|data/outputs|data/uploads|data/seedance-runs|config/avatars\.json|config/local-voices\.json|\.env)$' && codesign --force --deep --sign - 'release/Digital Human Studio-darwin-arm64/Digital Human Studio.app'
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:mac && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent 'release/Digital Human Studio-darwin-arm64/Digital Human Studio.app' 'release/Digital-Human-Studio-0.4.3-macOS-arm64.zip'
